newsitem.title: USA: XCL, Apache Chinese appraisal successful.
newsitem.headline: XCL, Apache Chinese appraisal successful.

text.p: XCL Ltd said Apache Corp, the operator, successfully drilled the D-3 appraisal well in the Zhao Dong Block of China.
XCL said the Bohai 7 rig which drilled the D-3 will move immediately to drill the C-4 wildcat well located northeast of the 1994 C-1 discovery, and, after that, to drill the D-4 well.

The D-3 was drilled to a total depth of 1,750 meters at a location north of the 1995 D-1 discovery well and east of the January 1997 D-2 well. The D-3 well has encountered multiple productive reservoirs which were successfully tested in the D-1 and D-2 wells, as well as additional productive reservoirs, XCL said.

Sufficient data has been collected from the D-3 well to confirm its productive capability without the necessity of redundant, expensive and time-consuming testing, the company said. Data from the D-3 will be incorporated into the Overall Development Program which is being finalized for submission to the Chinese government.
XCL and Apache each own a 50 percent interest in the Foreign Contractor's share of the Zhoa Dong Block.
